Track 2.3: Text Cleaning in RAG Systems
Detailed Guidelines
Objective
The purpose of Text Cleaning is to convert raw extracted text from PDFs, DOCX files, websites, or scanned documents into a clean and standardized format before chunking and embedding generation.
A poorly cleaned document leads to:
Irrelevant chunks
Poor retrieval accuracy
Increased hallucinations
Wasted storage and computation
Why Text Cleaning is Important
Consider the following text extracted from a PDF:
Page 1
Research Paper on Artificial Intelligence
Introduction
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming industries.
Page 2
Research Paper on Artificial Intelligence
Literature Review
Problems:
Page numbers
Repeated headers
Separator lines
Extra blank spaces
Formatting noise
If stored directly in a vector database, retrieval quality decreases significantly.
Text Cleaning Workflow
Raw Document
↓
Text Extraction
↓
Remove Noise
↓
Normalize Text
↓
Validate Output
↓
Chunking
Artificial	Intelligence	is	transforming industries.
Solution
import re
text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
Output
Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries.
Introduction
Artificial Intelligence
Solution
text = re.sub(r'\n+', '\n', text)
Output
Introduction
Artificial Intelligence
Page 1
Page 2
Page 3
Solution
text = re.sub(r'Page\s+\d+', '', text)
Every page contains:
XYZ University Research Report
Solution
text = text.replace(
"XYZ University Research Report", ""
)
For dynamic detection:
from collections import Counter
Identify frequently repeated lines and remove them.
@@@@ Artificial Intelligence ####
Solution
text = re.sub(
r'[^a-zA-Z0-9\s.,!?;:()-]', '',
text
)
Output
Artificial Intelligence
PDF extraction often gives:
Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries and creating new opportunities.
Solution
text = text.replace("\n", " ")
Output
Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries and creating new opportunities.
“AI” ’Machine Learning’
Different quotation marks may cause inconsistencies.
Solution
import unicodedata
text = unicodedata.normalize( "NFKD",
text
)
Visit https://example.com
Solution
text = re.sub( r'http\S+', '',
text
)
Contact: abc@gmail.com
Solution
text = re.sub( r'\S+@\S+', '',
text
)
Scanned PDFs often generate:
Mach1ne Learn1ng ArtificiaI Intelligence
Libraries:
pip install textblob
pip install pyspellchecker
Example:
from spellchecker import SpellChecker spell = SpellChecker()
Note: Use carefully because technical terms may be incorrectly modified.
Example
Copyright © 2026 All Rights Reserved
These lines are usually useless for retrieval. Remove them using:
text = text.replace(
"All Rights Reserved", ""
)
Do NOT remove:
Section titles
Headings
Tables (if important)
References (if needed)
Technical terms
Equations Bad Example:
Chapter 3: Transformer Architecture
Removing this heading can reduce retrieval quality.
Basic Cleaning
import re
import unicodedata
NLP-Based Cleaning
pip install nltk pip install spacy
Libraries:
NLTK
SpaCy Used for:
Tokenization
Lemmatization
Stopword handling
Enterprise Document Processing
pip install unstructured
Useful for:
PDFs
DOCX
PPTX
HTML
Emails
import re
import unicodedata def clean_text(text):
text = unicodedata.normalize( "NFKD",
text
)
text = re.sub( r'Page\s+\d+', '',
text
)
text = re.sub( r'\s+',
' ',
text
)
text = re.sub( r'http\S+', '',
text
)
return text.strip()
Objective
Build a Text Cleaning Module for a RAG Pipeline.
Input
PDF
DOCX
TXT
Tasks
Extract raw text.
Remove page numbers.
Remove headers/footers.
Remove unwanted symbols.
Normalize spaces.
Normalize Unicode characters.
Generate a cleaned text file.
Output
Input: raw_document.txt
Output: clean_document.txt
